items.title: Tom McIntosh — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I got a letter from President George W. Bush.

ctx.x: Okay. Thank you, thank you very much. Thank you for allowing these dear friends of mine to partake in the whole thing. Thank you for opening what seems a possible means by which, a door, this thing what I’ve been doing, this bigger
story, as you say, that hasn’t been told, some measure can be shared. In fact, I got a letter from President George W. Bush.
I saw it on the wall upstairs.
